Place: A civilian orbital recreation deck with a short hydrotherapy current track and low padded benches.
Activity: She detaches her flotation cape and hangs it on the bench rail before checking the current indicator with her fingertips.
Pose: Standing nearly front-on beside the pool, one hand places the cape on the rail and the other rests lightly on the indicator.
